Class GameConfig

java.lang.Object
com.mygame.config.GameConfig
public final class GameConfig extends Object
Immutable, validated runtime settings loaded from the external config.xml document.

Every section and attribute is required. Units, accepted ranges, and the absence of defaults are documented in the root config.xml.

    • load

      public static GameConfig load(String filename)
      Loads and validates a configuration file from the local filesystem.
      Parameters:
      filename - path to an XML document with a gameConfig root
      Returns:
      immutable settings read from the document
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the file is missing, malformed, or fails validation
